choice.basis: The state prevalence dashboard (chart) shows Pennsylvania (PA) as the state with the highest prevalence of Species Z, indicated by its darkest red color, which corresponds to the highest value on the scale (near 100). The public task explicitly instructs to route the record for the highest-prevalence state into the priority follow-up workflow. Among the options, only 'Open Pennsylvania (PA) prevalence detail for priority follow-up' matches both the visual evidence from the chart and the routing criterion specified in the public task.
choice.option_label: Open Pennsylvania (PA) prevalence detail for priority follow-up
